name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> game function. The '_id_9' suffix is a meaningful spell domain ID (spell ids 00h-23h), not an address residue: the literal 9 is baked into the body (PUSH 0x9 at the impact-animation, MP-deduct, and damage-calc call sites). spell id 9 = 咒殺術, an attack spell with AoE radius 範圍=0, which is exactly why this is a dedicated SINGLE-TARGET worker (no per-target loop; only target[0] is damaged). 'execute_offensive_single_target_spell' accurately describes the behavior.
purpose: Dedicated single-target offensive spell worker for spell id 9 (咒殺術, AoE radius 0): animate impact, deduct MP, apply magic damage to target[0], show damage/miss, composite frame, animate projectile paths.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x18) stack probe. Reset data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx=0. fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target(caster, 9, n_targets, target_id_array) -- the 2nd param (target count) is forwarded as the impact animation's 3rd arg so the sprite covers all selected targets even though only target[0] is hit. fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster, 9). damage = fd2_calc_magic_damage(target_id_array[0], 9). If damage==0 -> fd2_show_miss_indicator(target[0]); else fd2_show_damage_number(damage, 0x5E='^', target[0]). fd2_composite_battle_frame(0); fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths(). Explicit POP EBX / RET (does NOT borrow the 0x21190 shared epilogue, unlike looping siblings 0x21227 / 0x213B7).

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Caster runtime_char index; passed as arg1 to fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target and fd2_deduct_caster_mp.
params.reason: Name accurately reflects use (caster unit index) and carries no address residue.

params.name: spell_arg
params.semantics: Number of selected targets. Forwarded verbatim as the 3rd arg (n_targets slot) to fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target so the impact sprite covers every selected target, even though only target[0] is damaged. The Ghidra plate already notes 'spell_arg (Ghidra var name) = actually n_targets'.
params.reason: Current name is generic/misleading -- 'spell_arg' implies a spell parameter, but the value is the selected-target count (the n_targets slot of the impact animation, matching how every sibling worker e.g. fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell names this positional param 'n_targets'). Rename recorded only; applied in Stage 2.

params.name: target_id_array
params.semantics: Pointer to a byte array of selected target unit ids; only [0] is consumed by the damage calc / miss / damage-number calls.
params.reason: Name accurately reflects the byte-array-of-target-ids role; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; drives visual presentation + state mutation (MP deduct, HP via fd2_calc_magic_damage, fx queue).

comment_original_issue: EAX-forwarding paragraph anchored the intervening-instruction range at 0x21513, which is actually the ADD ESP,0xc AFTER the fd2_calc_magic_damage call; the real intervening instructions are 0x21507 MOVZX EBX / 0x2150B PUSH 0x5E before 0x2150D PUSH EAX. Also missing the game-data rationale (spell 9 = 咒殺術, AoE radius 0) that explains why it is single-target.
notes: Function reached ONLY via spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01 entry index 9 (0x51D01 + 0x24 = 0x51D25; confirmed: table[9] little-endian bytes 'ad 14 02 00' = 0x214AD; get_xrefs_to returns only 'From 00051d25 [DATA]'). Disassembly verified: explicit POP EBX/RET at 0x21526 (not a shared-epilogue tail jump), no second blink/flash animation, only target[0] consumed. KB cross-check: spell 9 = 咒殺術 攻擊法術, 範圍(AoE)=0, MP=30, 命中%=50, 最大傷害=999 -- single-target by design. No logic/equivalence concerns. Plate left unchanged (consistent with refined understanding, already notes spell_arg==n_targets).
